About Ava Digital Agency | Family-Run Marketing Experts in Illinois

Our Story

Ava Digital Agency was founded in Glen Ellyn, Illinois with a simple mission: help local businesses harness the power of AI-driven digital marketing to achieve real, measurable growth. What started as a one-person operation has grown into a dedicated team of marketing specialists, developers, and strategists—all united by a commitment to delivering results that matter.

The name Ava represents our core values: Authenticity, Vision, and Action. We believe in being genuine with our clients, seeing the bigger picture for their businesses, and taking decisive steps to make that vision a reality.

Meet Glen Patel, Founder

Glen Patel founded Ava Digital Agency after spending over a decade in the digital marketing industry, working with businesses ranging from local startups to Fortune 500 companies. He noticed a gap in the market: while big agencies offered sophisticated tools, they often lacked the personal touch and deep understanding of local Illinois markets that small and medium businesses needed.

“I started Ava Digital because I believe every business deserves access to enterprise-level marketing expertise, delivered with the personal attention and local knowledge that only a dedicated partner can provide,” says Glen.

Family-Run, Results-Driven

Ava Digital is a family-run business. This is not just a tagline—it is the foundation of how we operate. When you work with us, you are not just another account number. You get direct access to decision-makers, consistent team members, genuine investment in your success, and local Illinois expertise.

Our Approach: AI-Powered, Human-Centered

We combine cutting-edge AI technology with human expertise to deliver marketing that works. Our AI tools help us analyze vast amounts of data, automate repetitive tasks, personalize marketing messages at scale, and predict trends in real-time.
